filename: Data Requirements for Quantifying the Background Ocean Carbon Sink Abstract.pdf
title: Data Requirements for Quantifying the Background Ocean Carbon Sink
testbed_rationale: While the authors describe using high-resolution CESM simulation output as a 'testbed' for observing system evaluation and reconstruction testing, this is a short conference abstract without data access details, and the task focuses on surface ocean gapfilling/observing system simulation rather than ML parameterization development.
pain_points: High natural variability and uncertainty of the background ocean carbon sink at local to regional scales
Sparse real-world surface ocean fCO2 observational coverage
Stringent error threshold required to detect marine CDR signals (< 2 μatm)
extraction_notes: Conference abstract from AGU Fall Meeting 2024. Specific ML model architectures within the pCO2-Residual method (Bennington et al., 2022) were not detailed in the text.
